items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: He used to like me also. He used to call me sandpaper

ctx.x: Was your family Catholic when you were young? Oh yeah, I was. You were all Catholic.

We all Catholic, yeah. Of course I understand. You know sometimes you get persuaded by something else, you know. And of course I was christened Catholic. Yeah. And I was persuaded by a lot of botched undertaker. Uh huh. Friends of mine, like I said, playing the bands. Well they, they weren't a person like you, they want you to be with them. Yeah, that's right. So you see I was Catholic and of course after I got certain aids, well they persuaded me. They wanted me to join masons. Well, I didn't, I didn't know. So…
You told us about that I think the other time we made the tape. Yeah, it's a call sandpaper. Like a drummer does.
